status: IN USE. Colors, typography, and logo colorway names are taken from the official Brand Guides 2023, and the referenced logo assets are all present. Add CMYK/Pantone before treating this as authoritative for print.

brand.name: The Crossing
brand.mission: Help people become fully devoted disciples of Christ by creating opportunities to explore truth, experience grace, and express love.

color_system.note: The Crossing uses a broad, earthy palette. Primary colors are the brand identifiers and set the tone; secondary colors add contrast and emphasis; neutrals ground everything. CMYK/Pantone to be added from Brand Guides for print.

crossing_blue.name: Crossing Blue
crossing_blue.note: The core brand color; the 'Limed Spruce' logo is this color.

armadillo.name: Armadillo
armadillo.note: Near-black; the 'Armadillo' logo is this color.

typography.note: The Crossing uses distinct typefaces by role. Bariol is the body font — it is NOT the wordmark; the logo is set in Viga.

display.role: Display / headlines — high character, used with restraint.
display.license: Commercial. Confirm license and source before embedding on the web.

secondary.role: Secondary headings and dependable supporting text.
secondary.license: Commercial. Confirm license and web-embedding rights.

logo.role: The wordmark / logo lockup is set in Viga. For logo use only — do not use as general body or heading type.
logo.license: Viga is an open-source font (SIL Open Font License), available on Google Fonts.

body.role: Main body font. Strikes the balance of legibility and subtle personality; keep to full paragraphs and running copy.
body.license: Commercial (atipo foundry). The Crossing holds Desktop, Webfont, and App/OTT licenses. Desktop .otf files: install-only, keep in the private repo — do NOT commit to this public repo. Web: serve licensed .woff2 from the webfont package (do not convert the desktop .otf).

web.note: Serve from the webfont-license package on this one domain.

alt_body.role: Alternate body font, for callouts or when Bariol needs a break.

script.role: Accent script for occasional highlights and callouts. Sparingly.

typography.web_fallback_stack: "Nunito Sans", "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

logos.clear_space_rule: Leave generous white space around the logo so it feels special and stands out. Height of clear space = 2/3 × the margin (per Brand Guides). Do not size the logo to fill the available space.

limed_spruce.name: Limed Spruce
limed_spruce.use: Primary logo. Use on white and light backgrounds.

armadillo.name: Armadillo
armadillo.use: Alternate to Limed Spruce on white and very light backgrounds.

crossing.description: The Crossing master logo: an interlocking-rings icon with the wordmark. Primary lockup is the stacked version; use horizontal only where stacked will not fit.

horizontal_url.note: Horizontal lockup with 'thecrossing.church' beneath the wordmark.

icon.note: Interlocking-rings mark only. Favicon, avatar, app icon.

circle.note: Available formats vary by colorway (from the current asset set).

youth_crossing.name: Youth Crossing
youth_crossing.description: Student ministry. 'YC' circle mark in several colorways, most with and without a grain texture.
youth_crossing.note: Grain PNGs are very large (7-8MB). Prefer SVG or the no-grain versions for screen/web.

principles: Reflect the mission language: explore truth, experience grace, express love.
Accessible to both long-time members and first-time guests.
Avoid theological jargon a newcomer would not understand.
Tangible and warm; hold the ancient and the future together; leave room for the artistic.

rules.primary_logo: Use the stacked Limed Spruce logo unless the horizontal version is required to fit the space.
rules.clear_space: Give the logo generous surrounding space so it feels special; never size it to fill all available space.
donts: Do not change the relationship (size/position) between the icon and the text.
Do not change the font of the wordmark.
Do not add text inside the logo's recommended clear-space margin.
Do not stretch or squash the logo.
Do not set the logo in a color that is not recommended (use Limed Spruce, Armadillo, or Pure White).

governance.source_of_truth: This repository (TheCrossing-Church/brand). The Rock BrandCentral page should point here rather than maintain its own copy.
governance.owner: Rock team (@TheCrossing-Church/rock-team) — owns both the brand content and the pipeline. CODEOWNERS assigns every path to this team. The IT team has read-only access and is not an owner.
governance.change_process: Commit directly to main. There is no branch protection and no required review today: changes are small enough to check in the diff and undo with 'git revert'. Pull requests are welcome but optional. See PRACTICES.md for the tighter process we intend to adopt later.
governance.internal_assets: Editable source files, licensed fonts (desktop .otf), and internal-only templates live in the private repo TheCrossing-Church/brand-internal and/or SharePoint.
governance.review_cadence: Reviewed whenever the brand changes. A standing quarterly review is a goal, not yet a practice — see PRACTICES.md.
